_help: Act 6, the road back (any route, once): act6.gd sets act6_desert_pick or act6_coast_pick first. If the thieves fled the same way (Germans: desert; Italians: coast), you find their trail: a journal clue and a lead for Act 7 (lead_station / lead_police). Then the guardian's servants at the night camp: ride on (everyone's fear +1, act6_night_ride) or hold (event fight_mummy_servants, end_fight). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act67.py.

trail_germans.speaker: player
trail_germans.line: Hoofprints, a lot of them, and a cold fire. Under the ash, a torn page in German: a train timetable, Cairo to Alexandria.

trail_italians.speaker: player
trail_italians.line: Tyre tracks on the coast road, and a ditched crate stencilled 'Ricambi Ferraro'. Truck parts. They'll need a garage in Cairo, and a permit to get trucks out of the city.

r_isabelle.speaker: isabelle
r_isabelle.line: I put two shots into it. It didn't even look at me. It's looking at the road behind us.

r_hargreaves.speaker: hargreaves
r_hargreaves.line: Everyone up. Back to back. Nobody goes for water alone, not tonight.

r_hassan.speaker: hassan
r_hassan.line: His servants. He sends them ahead to see where the amulet goes. They are not here for us. Not yet.

r_eleanor.speaker: eleanor
r_eleanor.line: Those wrappings... they're the same as the bodies in the lower halls. It walked here. All this way.

r_youssef.speaker: youssef
r_youssef.line: I am not afraid. I am not afraid. I am... a little afraid.

choose.speaker: player
choose.line: It isn't coming closer. Not yet.

choices.label: Break camp and ride
choices.line: Pack up. We ride now, in the dark.

choices.label: Hold the camp
choices.line: Nobody runs. We hold here until morning.

hold.speaker: player
hold.line: Shapes come out of the dark, more of them now.

rode.speaker: player
rode.line: We ride through the night. Nobody talks. In the morning there are only our own tracks behind us.

night_falls.speaker: player
night_falls.line: The second night. Something stands at the edge of the firelight, very still, and it isn't a man.

f_eleanor_idle.speaker: eleanor
f_eleanor_idle.line: Nothing much. Just thinking. Go on, I'm fine.

f_eleanor_r0_b.speaker: eleanor
f_eleanor_r0_b.line: Wonderful. I'll write that down too.

f_eleanor_r0.speaker: eleanor
f_eleanor_r0.line: Sand in the ink, sand in the bread. I'd no idea the desert got into everything.

choices.label: Laugh with her
choices.line: Wait till it's in your boots.

choices.label: Tell her it gets worse
choices.line: It gets worse further west.

f_eleanor_r1_a.speaker: eleanor
f_eleanor_r1_a.line: That's what I mean to find out.

f_eleanor_r1_b.speaker: eleanor
f_eleanor_r1_b.line: To a dealer. Not to me.

f_eleanor_r1.speaker: eleanor
f_eleanor_r1.line: Three papyri in the museum's basement name a king who appears on no list. Someone went to a great deal of trouble to forget him.

choices.label: Ask her why
choices.line: Why would anyone bother?

choices.label: Ask what he's worth
choices.line: Is a forgotten king worth more?

f_eleanor_r2_a.speaker: eleanor
f_eleanor_r2_a.line: Then I'd better not be wrong.

f_eleanor_r2_b.speaker: eleanor
f_eleanor_r2_b.line: Then I'll find them on my own.

f_eleanor_r2.speaker: eleanor
f_eleanor_r2.line: Do you think it's really out there? Not the gold. The answers.

choices.label: Say you believe it
choices.line: I know it is. And you'll be the one who reads it.

choices.label: Say it's a payday
choices.line: I think it's a payday. Answers are your department.

f_eleanor_r3_a.speaker: eleanor
f_eleanor_r3_a.line: ...Thank you. I'll hold you to that.

f_eleanor_r3.speaker: eleanor
f_eleanor_r3.line: At the museum they let me translate and never let me sign. Whatever we find out here, I want my name on it.

choices.label: Promise her
choices.line: Your name, your work. You have my word.

choices.label: Make no promises
choices.line: Let's find it first, then argue about the credit.

f_pembroke_r0_b.speaker: pembroke
f_pembroke_r0_b.line: That is what everyone says before they aren't.

f_pembroke_r0.speaker: pembroke
f_pembroke_r0.line: You've packed the plates badly. The camera will survive. The plates may not.

choices.label: Let him repack
choices.line: Repack them however you like, Doctor.

choices.label: Tell him they're fine
choices.line: They'll be fine.

f_pembroke_r1_b.speaker: pembroke
f_pembroke_r1_b.line: Somebody has to care, or this is just looting.

f_pembroke_r1.speaker: pembroke
f_pembroke_r1.line: Forty sherds catalogued since Cairo. All Roman, all worthless, all properly labelled.

choices.label: Encourage him
choices.line: Keep at it, Doctor. When we get there, it'll matter.

choices.label: Mock him
choices.line: Nobody's going to care about your pots.

f_pembroke_r2_a.speaker: pembroke
f_pembroke_r2_a.line: Good. Then we understand each other.

f_pembroke_r2_b.speaker: pembroke
f_pembroke_r2_b.line: Then we shall lose the race and keep the book.

f_pembroke_r2.speaker: pembroke
f_pembroke_r2.line: A site is a book you can only read once. Dig it badly and the page is gone. I'd like us to read it properly.

choices.label: Agree with him
choices.line: Then we read it properly.

choices.label: Say time matters more
choices.line: We're racing two expeditions, Doctor.

f_pembroke_r3_b.speaker: pembroke
f_pembroke_r3_b.line: Does it matter? It had my name on it.

f_pembroke_r3.speaker: pembroke
f_pembroke_r3.line: Wadi Natrun, 1919. Bad funding, worse records. Half the finds vanished before they were catalogued, and my name went with them.

choices.label: Promise every find recorded
choices.line: Not this time. Every find goes on paper before anyone touches it.

choices.label: Ask whose fault it was
choices.line: Was it your fault?

f_hassan_idle.speaker: hassan
f_hassan_idle.line: Sit if you like. The fire is good company.

f_hassan_r0_a.speaker: hassan
f_hassan_r0_a.line: Then the desert is already teaching us something.

f_hassan_r0_b.speaker: hassan
f_hassan_r0_b.line: At my age sleep is a negotiation.

f_hassan_r0.speaker: hassan
f_hassan_r0.line: The stars are very clear tonight. In Cairo you forget there are so many.

choices.label: Look up with him
choices.line: I'd forgotten too.

choices.label: Ask if he's tired
choices.line: You should sleep, Doctor.

f_hassan_r1_a.speaker: hassan
f_hassan_r1_a.line: Then we share a question, if not yet an answer.

f_hassan_r1_b.speaker: hassan
f_hassan_r1_b.line: Honest, at least. Gold has buried more men than the desert.

f_hassan_r1.speaker: hassan
f_hassan_r1.line: Tell me, now that we are on the road. Why Akmentar, for you?

choices.label: To see what's there
choices.line: Someone tried very hard to make the world forget it. I want to know why.

choices.label: For the treasure
choices.line: There's a king's gold out there.

f_hassan_r2_a.speaker: hassan
f_hassan_r2_a.line: Because some things are not gone. Only covered.

f_hassan_r2.speaker: hassan
f_hassan_r2.line: Do you know why the old priests called it the Veil?

choices.label: Ask him to tell you
choices.line: Tell me.

choices.label: Save it for later
choices.line: Save the stories for when we get there.

f_hassan_r3_a.speaker: hassan
f_hassan_r3_a.line: Then I am glad I came.

f_hassan_r3_b.speaker: hassan
f_hassan_r3_b.line: Then I shall have to find other ways of being heard.

f_hassan_r3.speaker: hassan
f_hassan_r3.line: I have waited thirty years to see that place. When I say a door should stay closed, will you listen?

choices.label: Promise to listen
choices.line: I'll listen. You have my word.

choices.label: Make no promises
choices.line: I'll decide about doors when I see them.

f_hargreaves_r0_a.speaker: hargreaves
f_hargreaves_r0_a.line: Army taught me one thing, anyway.

f_hargreaves_r0_b.speaker: hargreaves
f_hargreaves_r0_b.line: Before the boots, if I'm honest.

f_hargreaves_r0.speaker: hargreaves
f_hargreaves_r0.line: Boots, rifle, water. In that order. Everything else is luxury.

choices.label: Agree
choices.line: Sound order.

choices.label: Ask about tea
choices.line: Where does tea come in?

f_hargreaves_r1_b.speaker: hargreaves
f_hargreaves_r1_b.line: Your call. I hope you don't regret it.

f_hargreaves_r1.speaker: hargreaves
f_hargreaves_r1.line: I'd like to drill the lads on the rifles each night. An hour. They'll thank me later.

choices.label: Let him drill them
choices.line: Do it.

choices.label: Let them rest
choices.line: They're exhausted, Tom. Let them sleep.

f_hargreaves_r2.speaker: hargreaves
f_hargreaves_r2.line: If it goes bad out there, and someone's hurt and can't walk, what do you do?

choices.label: Carry them
choices.line: We carry them. Nobody gets left behind.

choices.label: Leave them, if I must
choices.line: If it's them or everyone, I leave them.

f_hargreaves_r3_a.speaker: hargreaves
f_hargreaves_r3_a.line: Kind of you. Doesn't stop the hearing.

f_hargreaves_r3.speaker: hargreaves
f_hargreaves_r3.line: Mesopotamia, 1917. An officer told us to leave the wounded at a well and march. I obeyed. I hear them most nights.

choices.label: Tell him it wasn't him
choices.line: That was his order, Tom. Not your choice.

f_idris_idle.speaker: idris
f_idris_idle.line: Nothing to report. Sleep; I will watch.

f_idris_r0_a.speaker: idris
f_idris_r0_a.line: Less. Always less. The sand loves oil.

f_idris_r0_b.speaker: idris
f_idris_r0_b.line: Yet. That word does a lot of work.

f_idris_r0.speaker: idris
f_idris_r0.line: You clean a rifle like a soldier. Too much oil.

choices.label: Ask how he does it
choices.line: Show me, then.

choices.label: Tell him it works
choices.line: It hasn't failed me yet.

f_idris_r1_a.speaker: idris
f_idris_r1_a.line: Good. I hope you never need to.

f_idris_r1.speaker: idris
f_idris_r1.line: Every thief in Cairo sells to someone, and I know most of the someones. If something valuable leaves that city, I can usually find out how.

choices.label: Remember it
choices.line: I'll remember that.

choices.label: Ask how he knows
choices.line: How does an honest man know thieves?

f_idris_r2_b.speaker: idris
f_idris_r2_b.line: My mind is always on the job. That is why I am alive.

f_idris_r2.speaker: idris
f_idris_r2.line: The merchants I guard never ask my name. You ask. It is strange.

choices.label: Say it should be normal
choices.line: It should be the least anyone does.

choices.label: Keep him on the job
choices.line: Keep your mind on the job, Idris.

f_idris_r3_a.speaker: idris
f_idris_r3_a.line: You are a strange kind of employer. A good kind.

f_idris_r3.speaker: idris
f_idris_r3.line: My sisters are in Omdurman. Everything I earn goes home. One of them has a place at the school now.

choices.label: Send them something
choices.line: Send them this from me. For the school.

choices.label: Be glad for him
choices.line: Good. That's the best thing this money will do.

f_isabelle_r0_b.speaker: isabelle
f_isabelle_r0_b.line: Maybe. Keep giving me reasons not to.

f_isabelle_r0.speaker: isabelle
f_isabelle_r0.line: You keep watching me as if I'm about to ride off.

choices.label: Tell her you're glad
choices.line: I'm just glad you're here.

choices.label: Ask if she would
choices.line: Would you?

f_isabelle_r1_b.speaker: isabelle
f_isabelle_r1_b.line: We'll see who does what, monsieur.

f_isabelle_r1.speaker: isabelle
f_isabelle_r1.line: In a fight I pick my own ground. Don't send me where you'd stand; send me where I can see.

choices.label: Agree
choices.line: Your ground, your call.

choices.label: Say you give the orders
choices.line: Out there you go where I say.

f_isabelle_r2.speaker: isabelle
f_isabelle_r2.line: Hargreaves thinks I take too many risks. Hargreaves has never been paid by the head.

choices.label: Ask about bounty work
choices.line: Is that what you did?

choices.label: Change the subject
choices.line: Let's talk about tomorrow.

f_isabelle_r3_b.speaker: isabelle
f_isabelle_r3_b.line: Somewhere he hopes I'll never look.

f_isabelle_r3.speaker: isabelle
f_isabelle_r3.line: Those men in McKenna's said I owed someone a shipment. I didn't. My partner did, and he left me holding the bill.

choices.label: Say you believe her
choices.line: I believe you.

choices.label: Ask where he is now
choices.line: Where's your partner now?

f_saleh_r0_a.speaker: saleh
f_saleh_r0_a.line: Good. Small sips. You are learning.

f_saleh_r0_b.speaker: saleh
f_saleh_r0_b.line: That is what the dead say.

f_saleh_r0.speaker: saleh
f_saleh_r0.line: Drink before you are thirsty. Thirst is the desert telling you it is already too late.

choices.label: Drink
choices.line: Then I'll drink.

choices.label: Say you're fine
choices.line: I'm not thirsty.

f_saleh_r1_a.speaker: saleh
f_saleh_r1_a.line: Good. The desert respects a careful man.

f_saleh_r1.speaker: saleh
f_saleh_r1.line: We are drinking more water than I planned. Tomorrow, half rations.

choices.label: Agree
choices.line: Half rations. Make sure everyone knows why.

choices.label: Overrule him
choices.line: We'll manage. People need their strength.

f_saleh_r2_a.speaker: saleh
f_saleh_r2_a.line: Then we will all come home.

f_saleh_r2_b.speaker: saleh
f_saleh_r2_b.line: The desert does not care who is ahead.

f_saleh_r2.speaker: saleh
f_saleh_r2.line: The others race. I do not like a race. When I say stop, will you stop?

choices.label: Promise to listen
choices.line: When you say stop, we stop.

choices.label: Say it depends
choices.line: Depends who's ahead of us.

f_saleh_r3.speaker: saleh
f_saleh_r3.line: I know three men who did not come back from this road. I led them. I have brought people home for forty years, and I remember the three.

choices.label: Ask their names
choices.line: Tell me their names.

choices.label: Tell him not this time
choices.line: Not this time. Not with you leading.

f_youssef_idle.speaker: youssef
f_youssef_idle.line: Tomorrow I will find us a shortcut. You will see.

f_youssef_r0_b.speaker: youssef
f_youssef_r0_b.line: Vultures. Let us not talk about vultures.

f_youssef_r0.speaker: youssef
f_youssef_r0.line: Did you see the hawk this morning? Following us since dawn. It is good luck. Probably.

choices.label: Say you saw it
choices.line: I saw it.

choices.label: Ask about bad luck
choices.line: And what's bad luck?

f_youssef_r1_b.speaker: youssef
f_youssef_r1_b.line: As you say. But I would have found it.

f_youssef_r1.speaker: youssef
f_youssef_r1.line: Let me scout ahead tomorrow, alone. I will find us a faster way.

choices.label: Let him go
choices.line: Go. Back by noon.

choices.label: Keep him close
choices.line: You stay with the column.

f_youssef_r2_a.speaker: youssef
f_youssef_r2_a.line: You guessed? ...Thank you for not saying.

f_youssef_r2_b.speaker: youssef
f_youssef_r2_b.line: Because nobody hires a boy who has not.

f_youssef_r2.speaker: youssef
f_youssef_r2.line: I have not been this far west before. Not truly. Saleh knows. He has not told anyone.

choices.label: Say you'd guessed
choices.line: I'd guessed. You're doing fine.

choices.label: Ask why he lied
choices.line: Why say you had?

f_youssef_r3.speaker: youssef
f_youssef_r3.line: When we find it, will you tell them? That I am the one who found the road? My uncle says I will never be anything.

choices.label: Promise him the credit
choices.line: If you find it, the road is yours. I'll tell them.

choices.label: Credit goes to whoever earns
choices.line: Credit goes to whoever earns it.

f_farid_r0_a.speaker: farid
f_farid_r0_a.line: You see? Business begins with a gift.

f_farid_r0_b.speaker: farid
f_farid_r0_b.line: No catch. A small debt of gratitude, only.

f_farid_r0.speaker: farid
f_farid_r0.line: Dates from Siwa. The best. Take one. No charge. This time.

choices.label: Take one
choices.line: Thank you.

choices.label: Ask the catch
choices.line: What's the catch?

f_farid_r1_a.speaker: farid
f_farid_r1_a.line: You will not even notice I was gone.

f_farid_r1_b.speaker: farid
f_farid_r1_b.line: Business never sleeps. But it can wait.

f_farid_r1.speaker: farid
f_farid_r1.line: There is a trader near here who owes me. Let me do a little business on the way.

choices.label: Let him trade
choices.line: Go ahead. Just don't slow us down.

choices.label: No side deals
choices.line: No side deals, Farid. Not on my time.

f_farid_r2_a.speaker: farid
f_farid_r2_a.line: At last, a man who appreciates arithmetic.

f_farid_r2.speaker: farid
f_farid_r2.line: Everyone in this caravan is counting something. Saleh counts water, Naguib counts camels. I count everything, so nobody has to worry.

choices.label: Thank him
choices.line: I'm glad someone does.

choices.label: Ask what he counts
choices.line: And what do you count about me?

f_farid_r3_a.speaker: farid
f_farid_r3_a.line: Twelve towns. He would have laughed. Then cried.

f_farid_r3_b.speaker: farid
f_farid_r3_b.line: This one I could not count at all. And I came.

f_farid_r3.speaker: farid
f_farid_r3.line: My father had a caravan of forty camels. He lost them all in one season, to one bad road. I have never once taken a road I had not counted twice.

choices.label: Say he's done well
choices.line: You've done better than forty camels.

choices.label: Ask if he's afraid
choices.line: Is this road counted twice?

f_mahmoud_idle.speaker: mahmoud
f_mahmoud_idle.line: My men are asleep. I should be too.

f_mahmoud_r0.speaker: mahmoud
f_mahmoud_r0.line: My men sing when they dig. If they stop singing, look up. Something is wrong.

choices.label: Ask what they sing
choices.line: What do they sing?

choices.label: Say you'll listen for it
choices.line: I'll listen.

f_mahmoud_r1_b.speaker: mahmoud
f_mahmoud_r1_b.line: Longer than you want. Shorter than a funeral.

f_mahmoud_r1.speaker: mahmoud
f_mahmoud_r1.line: The sand here is soft on top and hard under. We will need shoring before we go deep.

choices.label: Trust his judgement
choices.line: Shore it however you think best.

choices.label: Ask how long
choices.line: How long will that take us?

f_mahmoud_r2_a.speaker: mahmoud
f_mahmoud_r2_a.line: I will tell them. They will dig twice as carefully.

f_mahmoud_r2_b.speaker: mahmoud
f_mahmoud_r2_b.line: That is how it always works.

f_mahmoud_r2.speaker: mahmoud
f_mahmoud_r2.line: My men ask: when we dig, whose name goes on the finds?

choices.label: Theirs
choices.line: The men who dig them up. The record says who found it.

choices.label: The expedition's
choices.line: The expedition's. That's how it works.

f_mahmoud_r3_a.speaker: mahmoud
f_mahmoud_r3_a.line: We will see. But thank you.

f_mahmoud_r3_b.speaker: mahmoud
f_mahmoud_r3_b.line: Fawzi. Like mine. Write it somewhere, if you like.

f_mahmoud_r3.speaker: mahmoud
f_mahmoud_r3.line: My men have dug for the British, the French and the Americans. Every one of them took the credit. My father dug at Karnak. His name is on nothing.

choices.label: Say that ends here
choices.line: Not on this dig.

choices.label: Ask his father's name
choices.line: What was his name?

f_khalil_idle.speaker: khalil
f_khalil_idle.line: The men are well. Thank you for asking.

f_khalil_r0_a.speaker: khalil
f_khalil_r0_a.line: Good. Then I did not lie.

f_khalil_r0_b.speaker: khalil
f_khalil_r0_b.line: Farid will want money for the meat.

f_khalil_r0.speaker: khalil
f_khalil_r0.line: The men want to know if there is meat tomorrow. I said yes. Is there meat tomorrow?

choices.label: Say yes
choices.line: There's meat tomorrow.

choices.label: Say ask Farid
choices.line: Ask Farid.

f_khalil_r1_a.speaker: khalil
f_khalil_r1_a.line: They will not forget this. Neither will I.

f_khalil_r1.speaker: khalil
f_khalil_r1.line: Two of my men are sick from the water.

choices.label: Give them your share
choices.line: Give them clean water from my ration.

choices.label: They'll toughen up
choices.line: They're grown men. They'll toughen up.

f_khalil_r2_a.speaker: khalil
f_khalil_r2_a.line: I will tell them you said so.

f_khalil_r2.speaker: khalil
f_khalil_r2.line: My men are dockworkers without docks. They carry. Nobody thinks they can do anything else.

choices.label: Say they're more than that
choices.line: They've done more than carry on this trip.

choices.label: Say carrying matters
choices.line: Somebody has to carry.

f_khalil_r3_a.speaker: khalil
f_khalil_r3_a.line: Then they will follow you down any hole.

f_khalil_r3_b.speaker: khalil
f_khalil_r3_b.line: Nothing. That is what happens to such men.

f_khalil_r3.speaker: khalil
f_khalil_r3.line: Half my men have been cheated before. A Frenchman left them in Luxor without a piastre. That is why they ask about pay.

choices.label: Promise they'll be paid
choices.line: Every man gets paid. In full.

choices.label: Ask about the Frenchman
choices.line: What happened to him?

f_naguib_idle.speaker: naguib
f_naguib_idle.line: Loads are fine. Camels are fine. I am fine.

f_naguib_r0_b.speaker: naguib
f_naguib_r0_b.line: The one that does not bite you. Today.

f_naguib_r0.speaker: naguib
f_naguib_r0.line: A good camel is worth three bad men. Do not tell the men.

choices.label: Laugh
choices.line: Your secret's safe.

choices.label: Ask which is best
choices.line: Which camel is best?

f_naguib_r1_a.speaker: naguib
f_naguib_r1_a.line: A wise choice. The camels thank you.

f_naguib_r1.speaker: naguib
f_naguib_r1.line: The camels are carrying too much. Lighten the loads, or we lose one by the end of the week.

choices.label: Lighten the loads
choices.line: Do it. Leave the spare crates.

choices.label: Push on
choices.line: We need everything. Push on.

f_naguib_r2_a.speaker: naguib
f_naguib_r2_a.line: It runs. Well is for God to say.

f_naguib_r2_b.speaker: naguib
f_naguib_r2_b.line: Every night is a long night.

f_naguib_r2.speaker: naguib
f_naguib_r2.line: Every load has a place, and every place has a load. When something is out of place, I cannot sleep.

choices.label: Say it shows
choices.line: It shows. The column runs well.

choices.label: Tease him
choices.line: Must be a long night, then.

f_naguib_r3_b.speaker: naguib
f_naguib_r3_b.line: They believed in going forward. Only forward.

f_naguib_r3.speaker: naguib
f_naguib_r3.line: I always pack for the way out. In the war, a column I carried for did not plan to come back. I did. Alone.

choices.label: Say he packs well
choices.line: Then pack for all of us.

choices.label: Ask what happened
choices.line: What happened to them?

night.speaker: player
night.line: Camp is made. The fire's going, and nobody's asleep yet.

choices.label: Turn in
choices.line: Get some rest. We ride at first light.
